Increase throughput capacity of a Lite topic If you don't use Lite reservations, you can set the throughput capacity of each partition of any zonal Lite topic to a value set by the following limits: Publish throughput between 4 and 16 MiBps Subscribe throughput between 4 and 32 MiBps These limits also apply to partitions associated with a Lite reservation.
If you do not use reservations for a zonal Lite topic, you must explicitly provision the publish and subscribe throughput capacity of the topic.
